LocalBusiness: A physical business or branch serving a local area. Also called shop, store, business, establishment. Examples: a restaurant, a bank branch, a clinic.
Store: A retail shop selling goods. Also called shop, retailer, outlet.
OnlineBusiness: A business operating online. Also called internet business, e-business, web business.
OnlineStore: An e-commerce website selling goods. Also called online shop, e-commerce site, web store.
OnlineMarketplace: An e-commerce platform where many sellers offer goods. Also called marketplace, online platform. Examples: Amazon, eBay.
FoodEstablishment: A business serving or selling food. Also called eatery, food outlet, food service.
Restaurant: A business serving prepared meals to diners. Also called eatery, diner, bistro, brasserie.
FastFoodRestaurant: A restaurant serving quick, inexpensive food. Also called fast food, quick-service restaurant. Examples: McDonald's.
CafeOrCoffeeShop: A small establishment serving coffee and light food. Also called cafe, coffee shop, coffeehouse.
BarOrPub: An establishment serving alcoholic drinks. Also called bar, pub, tavern, saloon.
Brewery: A facility that brews beer. Also called beer maker, brewhouse.
Distillery: A facility that distils spirits. Also called spirits maker.
Winery: A facility that makes wine. Also called vineyard, wine producer.
Bakery: A shop that makes and sells bread and pastries. Also called bakehouse, patisserie.
IceCreamShop: A shop selling ice cream. Also called gelateria, creamery.
Casino: A venue for gambling games. Also called gambling house, gaming house.
NightClub: A late-night venue for music and dancing. Also called club, discotheque, disco.
ComedyClub: A venue hosting stand-up comedy. Also called comedy venue.
BowlingAlley: A venue with lanes for bowling. Also called bowling centre.
AmusementPark: A park with rides and attractions. Also called theme park, funfair, fairground. Examples: Disneyland.
ArtGallery: A space exhibiting and often selling art. Also called gallery, art space.
Library: A collection of books and resources available to borrow. Also called lending library, public library.
LibrarySystem: A collaborative network of several libraries. Also called library network, library consortium.
ArchiveOrganization: An organisation that keeps and preserves archival records. Also called archive, records repository.
AdultEntertainment: An establishment offering adult entertainment. Also called adult venue.
AnimalShelter: A facility housing stray or rescued animals. Also called pound, rescue centre.
EntertainmentBusiness: A business providing entertainment. Also called entertainment venue.
EmergencyService: A service responding to emergencies. Also called first responders. Examples: fire brigade, ambulance, ER.
GovernmentOffice: A local office of a government agency. Also called public office, civic office. Examples: a DMV or tax office.
PostOffice: A facility handling postal mail services. Also called mail office.
MedicalOrganization: An organisation providing medical care. Also called healthcare provider, medical institution. Examples: a hospital, a clinic.
MedicalBusiness: A business run by health professionals. Also called medical practice, health business.
MedicalClinic: A facility for diagnosis and outpatient healthcare. Also called clinic, health centre, outpatient clinic.
PhysiciansOffice: A doctor's office or practice. Also called doctor's surgery, medical office.
Dentist: A dental practice or dentist's office. Also called dental surgery, dental clinic.
CovidTestingFacility: A clinic offering COVID-19 testing. Also called testing site, test centre.
DiagnosticLab: A laboratory offering diagnostic testing. Also called medical lab, pathology lab.
Pharmacy: A shop dispensing medicines. Also called drugstore, chemist, apothecary.
VeterinaryCare: A clinic providing animal medical care. Also called vet, veterinary practice.
Optician: A shop selling glasses and vision aids. Also called opticians, eyewear store.
Hostel: Cheap lodging with shared dormitories. Also called backpackers, youth hostel.
Motel: Roadside lodging for motorists. Also called motor lodge, motor inn.
BedAndBreakfast: A small lodging offering a room and breakfast. Also called B&B, guesthouse.
LodgingBusiness: A business providing lodging. Also called accommodation provider, hotel business, inn.
Cooperative: An organisation jointly owned by its members. Also called co-op, mutual.
WorkersUnion: An organisation representing workers in collective bargaining. Also called trade union, labour union, labor union.
Project: A planned collaborative enterprise to achieve an aim. Also called initiative, programme, venture.
ResearchProject: A project to conduct research. Also called research programme, study project.
FundingAgency: An organisation that manages and awards grant funding. Also called grant body, funder. Examples: NIH, the Gates Foundation.
FundingScheme: A grant-based funding programme with set guidelines. Also called grant programme, funding programme. Examples: Horizon 2020.
SearchRescueOrganization: An organisation that conducts search and rescue. Also called SAR organisation, rescue service.
PerformingGroup: A group that performs together, such as a band or circus. Also called troupe, ensemble, company.
TheaterGroup: A company that stages theatrical productions. Also called theatre company, drama troupe.
RadioStation: An organisation that broadcasts radio. Also called radio broadcaster, radio channel.
TelevisionStation: An organisation that broadcasts television. Also called TV station, TV broadcaster, TV channel.
SportsActivityLocation: A facility for sports activity. Also called sports facility, sports venue.
SportsClub: A club organised around a sport. Also called athletic club.
ExerciseGym: A facility with equipment for exercise. Also called gym, fitness centre.
HealthClub: A facility for fitness and wellness. Also called fitness club, gym, leisure centre.
PublicSwimmingPool: A public pool for swimming. Also called swimming baths, lido.
GolfCourse: Grounds laid out for playing golf. Also called golf links.
TennisComplex: A facility with tennis courts. Also called tennis centre, tennis club.
FinancialService: A business providing financial services. Also called finance company, financial institution.
BankOrCreditUnion: An institution holding deposits and lending money. Also called bank, credit union, savings institution.
AutomatedTeller: A cash machine for banking transactions. Also called ATM, cash machine, cashpoint.
InsuranceAgency: A business selling insurance. Also called insurer, insurance broker.
AccountingService: A business providing accountancy services. Also called accountant, accountancy firm.
LegalService: A business providing legal services. Also called law firm, legal practice.
Attorney: A legal practitioner; lawyer (deprecated, use LegalService). Also called lawyer, solicitor.
Notary: A person or office authorised to certify legal documents. Also called notary public.
EmploymentAgency: A business that matches workers with jobs. Also called recruitment agency, staffing agency.
TravelAgency: A business arranging travel and bookings. Also called travel agent, tour operator.
TouristInformationCenter: An office providing tourist information. Also called visitor centre, tourist office.
RealEstateAgent: A business that sells or rents property. Also called estate agent, realtor.
ProfessionalService: A provider of professional services (deprecated). Also called professional firm.
AutomotiveBusiness: A business for car sales, repair, or parts. Also called auto business, motor trade.
AutoDealer: A business selling cars. Also called car dealership, auto dealership.
AutoRental: A business renting out cars. Also called car hire, car rental.
AutoRepair: A business repairing cars. Also called garage, auto shop, mechanic.
AutoBodyShop: A shop repairing vehicle bodywork. Also called body shop, panel beater.
AutoPartsStore: A shop selling car parts. Also called auto parts shop, spares shop.
AutoWash: A facility for washing cars. Also called car wash.
GasStation: A facility selling vehicle fuel. Also called petrol station, filling station, service station.
MotorcycleDealer: A business selling motorcycles. Also called motorbike dealer.
MotorcycleRepair: A shop repairing motorcycles. Also called motorbike garage.
GeneralContractor: A business managing construction projects. Also called builder, building contractor.
Electrician: A tradesperson installing and repairing electrical systems. Also called electrical contractor.
Plumber: A tradesperson installing and repairing plumbing. Also called plumbing service.
HousePainter: A tradesperson who paints buildings. Also called painter, decorator.
RoofingContractor: A business installing and repairing roofs. Also called roofer.
Locksmith: A tradesperson making and repairing locks and keys. Also called lock specialist.
HVACBusiness: A business installing heating, ventilation, and air conditioning. Also called HVAC contractor.
MovingCompany: A business that moves household or office goods. Also called removals company, movers.
DryCleaningOrLaundry: A business cleaning clothes. Also called laundry, dry cleaner, launderette.
SelfStorage: A facility renting storage units. Also called storage facility, storage units.
RecyclingCenter: A facility that collects and processes recyclables. Also called recycling depot.
ChildCare: A facility caring for young children. Also called daycare, nursery, creche.
DaySpa: A facility offering beauty and wellness treatments. Also called spa.
BeautySalon: A business offering beauty treatments. Also called beauty parlour.
HairSalon: A business offering haircuts and styling. Also called hairdresser, barber shop.
NailSalon: A business offering manicures and pedicures. Also called nail bar.
TattooParlor: A studio offering tattoos. Also called tattoo studio.
HealthAndBeautyBusiness: A business offering health and beauty services. Also called wellness business.
InternetCafe: A venue offering public internet access. Also called cybercafe.
ShoppingCenter: A complex of many shops. Also called mall, shopping mall, shopping centre.
DepartmentStore: A large store with many departments of goods. Also called department shop. Examples: Macy's.
GroceryStore: A shop selling food and household goods. Also called supermarket, grocer, food store.
ConvenienceStore: A small shop selling everyday items with long hours. Also called corner shop, mini-mart.
WholesaleStore: A store selling goods in bulk to resellers. Also called wholesaler, cash-and-carry.
OutletStore: A store selling discounted or surplus goods. Also called outlet, factory shop.
ClothingStore: A shop selling clothes. Also called clothes shop, apparel store, boutique.
MensClothingStore: A shop selling men's clothing. Also called menswear store.
ShoeStore: A shop selling footwear. Also called footwear store.
JewelryStore: A shop selling jewellery. Also called jeweller.
BookStore: A shop selling books. Also called bookshop, bookseller.
MusicStore: A shop selling music or instruments. Also called record shop, music shop.
MovieRentalStore: A shop renting out films. Also called video rental store.
ElectronicsStore: A shop selling consumer electronics. Also called electronics shop.
ComputerStore: A shop selling computers. Also called computer shop.
MobilePhoneStore: A shop selling mobile phones. Also called phone shop, mobile store.
OfficeEquipmentStore: A shop selling office equipment. Also called office supplies store, stationery store.
FurnitureStore: A shop selling furniture. Also called furniture shop.
HomeGoodsStore: A shop selling household goods. Also called homeware store.
HardwareStore: A shop selling tools and building supplies. Also called DIY store, ironmonger.
GardenStore: A shop selling plants and gardening supplies. Also called garden centre, nursery.
Florist: A shop selling flowers. Also called flower shop, flower stall.
PetStore: A shop selling pets and pet supplies. Also called pet shop.
ToyStore: A shop selling toys. Also called toy shop.
SportingGoodsStore: A shop selling sports equipment. Also called sports shop.
BikeStore: A shop selling bicycles. Also called bike shop, cycle shop.
HobbyShop: A shop selling hobby and craft supplies. Also called craft store, hobby store.
LiquorStore: A shop selling alcoholic drinks. Also called off-licence, bottle shop.
TireShop: A shop selling and fitting tyres. Also called tyre shop.
PawnShop: A shop lending money against pledged goods. Also called pawnbroker.
